content:
**Scoped-up**, formerly **Expert Rifleman**, is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *Gone Fission* update.

Scoped weapons have more range when aiming.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 2 | Your scoped weapons have 50% more range when aiming. | 002EBD2A | 

Before update 60, the perk was named "Expert Rifleman." It used to have 3 ranks that provided +10%/+15%/+20% damage to non-automatic rifles.
